findings.evidence: tests/phase-6b-d110c-0c1f5b0d-reclamation-red.test.ts:180-195 asserts only that four store sources contain the string "pruneAuthenticatedSettledPrefix", while tests/phase-6b-d110c-0c1f5b0d-reclamation-red.test.ts:95-101 falls back to prunePublishedPrefix when the method is absent.
